text:
A support/debuffer built on spiritual manipulation - communion, curses, tethers and dimensional magic. Contributes meaningful damage and setup without competing with Sorcerer's raw DPS.

Primary: WIS | Secondary: INT

MP mechanic: MP regenerates natively for spell costs.

Spells:
Spirit Burst - single-target spirit damage
Unravel - strips magical enhancements from an enemy
Stasis - freeze + invulnerable AoE
Regression - dispel/cleanse for a single ally
Blooming Life - evolving heal-over-time
Stacia's Shrine - evolving shrine, heals then adds attack buff, then shield, then speed at higher levels
Stacia's Pulse - boomerang, damages enemies and heals allies on both directions
Spirit Rend - evolving mark, amplifies magical damage taken
Soul Tether - bind souls with an ally, sharing a portion of healing received
Communion Rite - evolving personal revive
Ethereal Step - short-range spirit teleport
Stacia's Judgment - evolving damage shrine, ultimately strikes twice

Passives:
Bloomkeeper - active Blooming Lifes boost your healing
Spiritual Attunement - a healing cast empowers your next non-healing spell
Spirit Overflow - healing received at full Health converts to Mana
